policies.name: personal_owner_insert
policies.check: (defectrag_is_staff() AND (owner_id = auth.uid()) AND (archived_at IS NULL) AND (archived_by IS NULL) AND ((payload ->> 'id'::text) = id) AND (image_path ~~ ((((auth.uid())::text || '/'::text) || id) || '/%'::text)) AND (heatmap_path ~~ ((((auth.uid())::text || '/'::text) || id) || '/%'::text)))

policies.name: personal_notes_owner_insert
policies.check:
(defectrag_is_staff() AND (author_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM personal_inspections i
 WHERE ((i.id = personal_notes.inspection_id) AND (i.owner_id = auth.uid()) AND (i.archived_at IS NULL)))))

policies.name: personal_notes_owner_read
policies.using:
(defectrag_is_staff() AND (author_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM personal_inspections i
 WHERE ((i.id = personal_notes.inspection_id) AND (i.owner_id = auth.uid())))))

triggers.name: personal_sync_version
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER personal_sync_version BEFORE UPDATE ON public.personal_inspections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION defectrag_personal_sync_version()

triggers.name: personal_sync_note_version
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER personal_sync_note_version AFTER INSERT ON public.personal_notes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION defectrag_personal_sync_note_version()

staff_guard_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.defectrag_is_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.staff_members s where s.user_id=auth.uid() and s.revoked_at is null)
 and exists(select 1 from public.defectrag_auth_settings c where c.singleton
 and (not c.mfa_required or public.defectrag_has_aal2()));
$function$
